thread:
ashley-docs: opened a docs PR to tidy SOC2 audit-log examples + retention wording. need quick eyes on snippets and one broken KMS link.
devon-eng: skimmed — prefer `actor_id` naming across examples (we standardized on `_id`). also the sample JSON shows `user_ip` which we shouldn't expose.
marta-legal: agree. redact IPs in public examples or show `<redacted>`. also add a short legal-hold note explaining overrides.
ashley-docs: plan: normalize field names to `actor_id`, replace IPs with `<redacted>`, add one-sentence legal-hold clause, and include minimal curl + python SDK examples for audit export with retention_days.
samir-ml: add a small migration note for teams moving from schema v1 to v2: map `actor`->`actor_id`, drop `user_ip` (or move to redacted field), and note default retention change from 365 -> 90 days for hosted.
ashley-docs: drafting migration blurb now. found two dead links to KMS docs — will update to the new FAQ path.
link-checker-bot: link-checker: docs/audit/export.md -> 404 in current tree.
devon-eng: that must be from last refactor; point to docs/security/kms-faq.md instead.
ashley-docs: updated link and added a redirect entry. also swapping example JSON to this minimal one per devon: ```json {"event_id":"evt_1234","timestamp":"2026-03-01T12:00:00Z","actor_id":"anon_abc123","action":"fetch","resource_type":"dataset"} ```
marta-legal: wording suggestion: "Actor identifiers in examples are pseudonymized. Production logs may contain additional identifiers subject to data-handling policies and legal holds."
ashley-docs: inserted that sentence inline. adding SDK snippets now: python `export_audit_log(retention_days=90)` and node `exportAuditLog({retentionDays:90})` minimal examples.
samir-ml: FYI remove stray paragraph referencing quantization — looks copy-pasted from a runtime doc; left a comment on the PR.
ashley-docs: removed that paragraph. CI showed a markdown lint around ordered list numbering; fixed.
ashley-docs: updated PR description to note PR number and migration notes for customers. merging after one more pass unless anyone objects. :shipit:
devon-eng: :thumbsup:
marta-legal: approved pending no raw IPs in examples.
link-checker-bot: all links validated in changed files.
notes: PR cleans audit-log docs: normalize field names, remove PII from samples, add migration note v1->v2, update KMS links and add short legal-hold wording.
